# function: yaml_diff

## Overview

`provider::lara-utils::yaml_diff()` computes a compact, git-style **unified diff** between two YAML documents and returns it as a string. It is intended to surface, at plan/apply time, exactly which values would change — for example, comparing the values currently applied to a `helm_release` against the values that are about to replace them.

Both inputs are parsed and re-serialized with deterministic (sorted) key ordering before being compared, so the resulting diff reflects only real value changes rather than incidental formatting or key-ordering differences.

When the two documents are semantically equal, an empty string is returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Compare the values currently applied to a helm_release against the values
# that are about to replace them, and surface a compact unified diff at plan time.

locals {
  current_values = helm_release.this.metadata[0].values # YAML currently applied
  new_values     = yamlencode(var.helm_values)          # YAML about to be applied
}

output "helm_values_diff" {
  value = provider::lara-utils::yaml_diff(local.current_values, local.new_values)
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
yaml_diff(current string, new string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `current` (String) The current/baseline YAML document (e.g. the values currently applied to a `helm_release`).
1. `new` (String) The new/proposed YAML document to compare against `current`.
